findings.rule: Heat treatment field must not be blank when a heat-treatment note is specified on the drawing.
findings.reasoning: The title block heat_treatment field is '---' while note N1 explicitly requires case hardening to 55–60 HRC with a 0.8–2 mm case depth. A manufacturer reading only the title block would skip heat treatment entirely, producing a soft part that fails in service.
findings.correction: Update the title block heat_treatment field to reference N1 or state 'Case Hardened 55-60 HRC per Note N1'.

findings.rule: Functional outer diameters on mating or locating features require an explicit tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: Dimensions D1 and D13 define the ⌀30 outer cylindrical surface (F1) of a pin sleeve but carry no tolerance. Under the general machining tolerances this defaults to ±0.5 mm, which is far too loose for a functional sleeve OD intended to locate or press-fit into a housing.
findings.correction: Add an appropriate tolerance or fit class (e.g., h6, h7) to D1 and D13 based on the mating assembly requirement.

findings.rule: Functional inner diameters on mating features require an explicit tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: Dimensions D4 and D12 define the ⌀20 inner bore (F2) but have no tolerance. The default general machining tolerance of ±0.5 mm is unacceptable for a functional bore that likely receives a pin or shaft.
findings.correction: Add an appropriate tolerance or fit class (e.g., H7) to D4 and D12 consistent with the intended fit.

findings.rule: Threads running into a shoulder or blind bottom require a thread-relief undercut or sufficient unthreaded lead-out.
findings.reasoning: Feature F4 specifies an M5 threaded hole 6 mm deep but provides no detail about a thread relief groove or drill-point clearance at the bottom. Without relief, the tap cannot produce full-form threads to the required depth and may break.
findings.correction: Add a thread-relief undercut or increase the drilled depth beyond 6 mm to allow the tap to run out without hitting a shoulder or blind bottom.

findings.rule: All notes on a released engineering drawing must convey meaningful manufacturing or inspection information.
findings.reasoning: Note N5 contains the text 'YFYFGHYFGHGF', which is gibberish and appears to be a placeholder or data-entry error. It has no engineering meaning and could confuse the shop floor.
findings.correction: Delete note N5 or replace it with the intended specification.
